story: How can I learn to program?
text: Here is an MIT Course: Introduction To CS and Programming [VIDEO] Professor keeps everything simple and direct because this class is designed for beginners with no or little programming experience.
I've really enjoyed watching the MIT 6.00 course (Introduction to Computer Science and Programming): [VIDEO] The Khan videos seem to be about programming instead of computer science.

story: Ask HN: How would a high schooler find CS mentor?
text: Make the entire Internet your mentor. It's filled with information and answers to all sorts of questions. Look at some programming tutorials such as codecademy. Maybe find some books on computer architecture, learn about mathematics that might apply to computer scientists. Here are some links to get you started. [LINK] [LINK] [LINK] [LINK] [LINK] [LINK] [LINK] Also, learn to use YouTube to search for answers. Check this video out. [VIDEO]
